about: The titles that close level 2 (docs/mechanics/finale-flight.md): the end track, its cues, and the way of the camera's flight to the stars. The stand (tools/chase) plays the flight from this file; the game does not read it yet.

track.about: bin/music/credits.ogg as tools/finale/beat_map.py hears it: its length in seconds, its tempo, and its first downbeat - the kick the band comes in on. A bar is four beats.

cues.about: Seconds of the track, which starts with the hull's burst; every cue but handOver stands on a downbeat. card - the first pulse heard; flash - the band comes in; credits - the starts of three sections; flight - the band drops out; turn - its kick comes back alone, bandIn - all of it; neon - a bar and a beat before the loudest chorus: the sign stutters as the eye goes by; rib - the loudest chorus begins: the eye leaves the dome close past a rib, and flare - the sun comes out of the glass on the same beat; crown - the drums leave; sky - the band comes back.

path.about: The eye's way, by the seconds of the flight. x - the place along the city's strip that stands in the middle of the screen at the domes' base line; null - where the world stood. dx in the stead of x - so far from where the world stood, below 0 to the left: the eye's way off the picture is the same after a fight of any length. A key to the right of the one before it is held at that one's place: the eye never flies to the right. y - up, z - into the screen, in the units of the layout's camera, from its rest (the eye rests 28 over the crater floor; the play layer stands 93 in, the near hills 219, the domes' base line 1024). bank - degrees, the left wing down turns the picture clockwise; pitch - degrees, the nose up. note - for the reader. Between the keys a monotone cubic, a channel at a time: through every key, never past one, still at the two ends. The way: cast off to the left through the track's break; the pan; the turn into the main dome at the pan's pace, the way to the left giving over to the way in; in through a cell of its front, up over the roofs, past the TEK sign on the spire; out through a cell of its back close under a node of the frame, banked, into the sun; the climb.

keys.note: the picture the world stands on
cast off through the break: the gate, the logo, then the hero on the barge ride off to the right; the kick comes back
the band is in: at speed along the strip
over the outskirts, the satellite dome coming
the last of the level pan: from here the eye turns in
past the satellite dome, the way in beginning
the turn: as much in as to the left; the near hills and the fangs go under the eye
straight at the main dome, at the pan's pace, rising to its slope
over the dome's foot: in through a cell of its front, a rib close on the right
over the roofs, between the spire and the pyramid: the TEK sign goes by on the left, stuttering
abreast of the spire; the bank begins
out through a cell of the dome's back, a rib close over and one close under; the sun
the climb: up faster and faster, the bank let go slowly
the ridge goes down the frame, the sun stays
the ridge's skyline leaves by the bottom edge; the nose comes up, the sun sinks
the sun low in the frame, alone
the sun leaves by the bottom edge
the black; the path stands still only here, where nothing shows it. From here the game: the stars of the menu
